profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with a passion and demonstrated ability to build a variety of Cyber Security products.

I am a back-end software engineer that specializes in enterprise software that is flexible and scalable. 
I write software that integrates with a wide array of cyber security and networking solutions. I enjoy working with both internal teams and external vendors and partners to be able to tackle complex challenges.

I have built and currently maintain large scale, cloud based, distributed systems.
I am also familiar with API driven design, with a focus on Python, Django, GraphQL, Kubernetes, Docker, ELK Stack, AWS, Celery, RabbitMQ and Memcached.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on designing and implementing integrations with best-of-breed
partners and products (EDR/XDR/SIEM) into our Zero Trust Analytics Platform (ZTAP).

My responsibilities included:

• Extend and maintain the functionality of a large scale, cloud based (AWS) Managed Detection and Response platform. This distributed system is purely API driven and containerized. It is built using Python, Django, Restless (API/ REST Framework), ELK Stack, Celery, RabbitMQ, Docker, Memcached.
• Design and implement backend APIs to support and facilitate security alert investigation within our MDR platform.
• Design and build new containerized microservices to extend the functionality of our platform. Use
Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform) to quickly deploy and maintain the state of required infrastructure in AWS.
• Monitor and resolve system issues using tools such as New Relic, Sentry, CloudWatch.
positions.insights: Skills: Microservices · Python · Django · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Terraform

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Compatibility Team

• Development of new plug ins and modules as appropriate to support 3rd party compatibility.
• Actively investigate ways to improve the supportability of Forescout products.
• Resolve defects in software as needed.
• Build, test and release software plug ins as necessary
• Verification of compatibility between Forescout and 3rd party software/hardware

positions.title: Sustaining Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Verification of compatibility between CounterACT and 3rd party software/hardware
• Build, test and release software plug ins as necessary

positions.title: IT Intern - Information Security
positions.description:
•	Wrote and documented scripts to facilitate Vulnerability Management using the Qualys platform
•	Participated in a team project to research and roll out company-wide collaboration tools
•	Worked on small projects that included documenting topics such as: penetration testing, memory forensics, Windows Event Forwarding and other cybersecurity related topics
